Licences:
* h5p-standalone 3.8.2 (Tunapanda): MIT, see LICENSE.
* frame.bundle.js bundles jQuery (MIT) and the H5P core JavaScript from h5p/h5p-php-library, whose repository is licensed
  GPL-3.0 ("The H5P PHP library is GPL licensed due to GPL code being used for purifying HTML provided by authors").
  The core runs only inside the activity's own sandboxed frame and talks to the app by postMessage. Whether that is enough
  separation is a licence decision for the owner (docs/activities-dev/h5p.md, "Licences").
* h5p.css and the two icon fonts come from the same H5P core.
